source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Curaçao 2026 Home Kit by Adidas Released
source.quote: The Curaçao Football Federation and adidas have revealed the Curaçao 2026 Home Kit, which will be worn by the national team throughout the 2026-2028 international cycle
source.note: Kit supplier, listed as partner per the convention. Football Shirt Culture's launch description lists every mark on the shirt: 'a yellow adidas logo on the right chest' next to the Federashon Futbòl Kòrsou crest, 'Yellow adidas Three Stripes run across the shoulders', and 'A “Curaçao” wordmark is placed beneath the rear collar'; no commercial sponsor logos are mentioned or visible on shirt, shorts or socks.

summary: Nothing on the shirt but the crest: adidas' 2026 home shirt carries no commercial sponsors, only a yellow adidas logo, the FFK crest and a 'Curaçao' wordmark below the back collar; shorts and socks likewise carry only adidas striping, the federation crest and Curaçao wording (Football Shirt Culture's launch description). Worn for the 2026-2028 international cycle, including the 2026 World Cup.
